digest.component_or_area: transition request handling across CLI, library, and MCP surfaces
propositions: Close-reason and force plumbing logic is duplicated across three surfaces (CLI transition.py:584, library _lib_writes.py:318, MCP _commands/txn.py:357-362) with inconsistent behavior: CLI refuses inadmissible reasons while library silently discards them.
The placeholder value '(no reason given)' is produced in five code locations across three files with no single source of truth, making it impossible to enforce one canonical placeholder.
MCP transition_ticket does not expose the reason parameter, creating a write-parity contract violation marked as strict-xfail and breaking the documented API surface.
A bare --force close of a reason-required class must remain accepted despite convergence on refusal behavior, requiring careful ordering of normalization relative to the refusal check.
The placeholder must never be normalized into close_disposition.verdict where it would transform an UNJUSTIFIED disposition into a SIGNED one due to the empty-reason failure path.

The library's force_close parameter is a deprecated public alias while close_ticket's force_close is internal; a unified TransitionRequest must retire this distinction without breaking the public API.
